properties.name: District 1
properties.lineNote: A second published copy of this map, kept by the University of Oklahoma, draws the line between Districts 1 and 2 differently over about 28 square kilometres in the north and east of Beaver County. This map follows the state Department of Transportation's copy. If you live near that line, the county election board can say which district you vote in.
